zh-Hans: 狠狠攻进去，踩下油门！不把这辆车最后一点潜力榨干，我绝不罢休！
en: Push harder and get on the gas! I'm not done until I've wrung every last bit out of this car!

zh-Hans: 冷静点。比起输赢，更重要的是把自己的本事全使出来！
en: Stay calm. What matters isn't winning or losing. It's giving it everything I've got!

zh-Hans: 我状态正好，已经跑到最好了！这到底怎么回事？
en: I'm in the groove! This is my best driving! What the hell is going on?

zh-Hans: 我状态正好，已经跑到最好了！
en: I'm in the groove! This is my best driving!
This rush is incredible!
He's one hell of a driver!
There's an aura about him!

zh-Hans: 最重要的还是享受驾驶吧。能随心所欲地摆出完美姿态，才叫痛快。我想，我就是为了这种乐趣才一直跑到现在。
en: What matters most is enjoying the drive. Getting the car into exactly the attitude you want feels so good. That's what keeps me racing.
Damn it!
He's got his nose in!
Damn it! I'm not giving way!
What?!

zh-Hans: 开什么玩笑！你到底在往哪儿开？！
en: You've got to be kidding! Where the hell are you driving?!
He passed me! Am I dreaming?
Ugh!
Ugh...
Damn, he's fast!

zh-Hans: 原来我对上的是这么厉害的车手。实力差距，我算是领教了！
en: What an incredible driver I'm up against. He's shown me just how far apart we are!

zh-Hans: 这股兴奋劲儿根本压不住！
en: I can't hold back this excitement!

zh-Hans: 他大概光是跟上就已经拼尽全力了。这场我能赢！
en: He's probably using everything he's got just to keep up. I can win this!

zh-Hans: 他大概光是跟上就已经拼尽全力了。
en: He's probably using everything he's got just to keep up.
I can win this!

zh-Hans: 他是很厉害，不过还没把我逼到绝路！
en: He's good, but I don't feel cornered yet!

zh-Hans: 哪怕只领先半个车身，主动权也在我手里！
en: Even half a car length ahead, I'm still in control!
I won't leave an opening!

zh-Hans: 非要硬跟，出了什么事可别怪我！
en: Keep forcing yourself to follow, and don't blame me for what happens!
Back off if you value your life!

zh-Hans: 我代表的是 SEVEN STAR，绝不能跑出让自己后悔的丢人表现！
en: I'm representing Seven Star Leaf. I won't embarrass myself with a run I'll regret!
He's right on me! Why?!

zh-Hans: 这车手太厉害了，甩不掉！
en: He's unbelievable! I can't shake him!

zh-Hans: 选择先跑，对我来说果然没错！
en: Choosing to lead was the right call!

zh-Hans: 较量的终究是车手和车手！
en: In the end, it's driver against driver!

zh-Hans: 只要轮胎进入状态，我这边就万无一失！
en: Once the tires are ready, I'm all set!

zh-Hans: 对手开什么车，跟我没关系！
en: I don't care what he's driving!

zh-Hans: 我只管跑出自己现在最好的水平！
en: I'll give him the best driving I've got!
I'm winning this, no matter what!
Right there! Got you!
I'll settle it here!
All right, I can do this!
You're not getting past!
Let's do this!
All right! Time to finish this!
Well then, let's get this started!

zh-Hans: 这家伙，说不定真有两下子！
en: This guy might really be something!
